claim: The card glides on buttery inertia — trailing the scroll like Lenis smooth-scroll made physical, easing into place when the page rests.

q1_defects.answer: Idle is a clean, ship-quality card (brass header, blue accent dot, 3 grey rows, rounded panel) matching the ground truth. play-3 shows the card glided up with momentum, chrome intact. BUT in the tiltDeg and span-high poses the card glides so far up that the brass header and accent dot are clipped OFF the top of the frame — only the lower ~2/3 (3 grey rows) remains. Borderline framing defect at the high end of travel.

q2_reads_as.answer: Reads as inertial glide: the card trails the scroll and is displaced up-frame across play frames with the chrome fully preserved, vs the centered idle. Matches the ground-truth card subject (same brass header/dot/3-rows). The momentum/overshoot displacement is legible.
evidence: metrics: play-1 delta=6.95 play-2 delta=10.26 play-3 delta=10.03 (motion present)

q3_discoverable.answer: The HEADLINE labeled control 'Smoothness' (the entire premise of the tile) is pixel-identical low/mid/high — the byte-identical 14955-byte files and metrics changed=false confirm it does nothing at the pinned engaged state. 'Tilt Degrees' is also pixel-identical (dead). Only 'span' visibly changes the frame. A user dragging the named 'Smoothness' slider sees no response — they cannot discover what the control does.

q4_responsive.answer: Play-phase motion is present and smooth (frameDeltaMag 6.95→10.26→10.03), and the span control responds. But 2 of 3 labeled controls are dead, including the headline one — by the rubric's '>1 control with no change = janky/dead' test this is janky at the control surface.
evidence: control: smoothness changed=false AND tiltDeg changed=false (2 of 3 dead)

q5_net.answer: A user would be ANNOYED: the card and glide look good, but the slider literally labeled 'Smoothness' — the one thing the tile advertises — does nothing, and at full travel the card's brass header scrolls off the top of the frame. The headline control must visibly change the smooth-scroll feel.

mustFix.issue: Headline 'Smoothness' control is dead — low/mid/high are byte-identical, no visible change at the pinned engaged state. This is the tile's namesake control and must visibly alter the inertia/easing feel.
mustFix.evidence: control: smoothness changed=false (scroll-inertia-glide/after/control-smoothness-low.png == control-smoothness-high.png, both 14955 bytes, luma=16.6 band=0.534)

mustFix.issue: Second labeled control 'Tilt Degrees' is also dead — low/mid/high pixel-identical, no frame change.
mustFix.evidence: control: tiltDeg changed=false (scroll-inertia-glide/after/control-tiltDeg-low.png == control-tiltDeg-high.png, luma=13.5 band=0.433)

flags.note: At max travel (tiltDeg/span-high poses) the card glides far enough that the brass header + accent dot clip off the top of the frame, leaving only the grey rows; the glide should keep the card body framed.
